title: Okay Futon
text:
Okay Futon. This is really easy to put together. The legs come in a secret zipper compartment underneath the cushion- so be sure to look there. I do like this futon. It does have a variety of seating options. It isn’t the most comfortable for sleeping, but definitely above normal futon grade. Really, the only thing I dislike about this futon is the fabric choice. It just shows dirt like crazy and is really hard to keep clean. Things tend to smear on it instead of wiping off. Pet hair is attracted to it. Crumbs are almost impossible to get out of the crevices. I would just think there would be something better to put on the surface of a futon. Something waterproof that isn’t so textured that is grabs onto everything.
The futon is high enough to put baskets underneath for storage, if you are so inclined. The arms go up in multiple levels. It is decently comfortable to sit on.

product_metadata.title: DHP Bailey Upholstered Futon, Black, Full
features: Upholstered in black microfiber with stainless steel slanted legs.
Combines comfort and quality with a 7" pillow top.
Multifunctional: seat cushions fold up as arms and the back can be adjusted for seating, lounging or sleeping.
Solid wood frame construction for support
description: Combining comfort, quality and style the DHP Premium Bailey Futon is the ultimate, most luxurious futon. Upholstered in black microfiber and stainless steel legs, this contemporary piece will add instant charm to any living space. With a lavish 7" pillow-top, the Bailey Futon is both soft and supportive to the body. Its unique design allows the seat cushions at either ends to be positioned differently – fold up as arms, fold down for a sleeper or drop only one for a lounger. Great for relaxing or entertaining, the DHP Premium Bailey Futon is the perfect contemporary piece!.
